items.item_text: 01. Temporary positions with SCCCD DO NOT turn into permanent positions. Do you understand this working condition? Options: Yes | No
02. Are you available for a temporary assignment at this time? Options: Yes | No

03. Experience Requirement: One year of full-time experience is equivalent to 12 months of employment at 40 hours per week. Qualifying part-time experience will be prorated based on its full-time equivalent. Experience must be directly related to the position. Education Requirement: Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units in a directly related field are equivalent to one (1) year of experience or one (1) year of school. All education and experience used to meet minimum qualifications must be clearly documented in the application. Do you understand this condition? Options: Yes | No

04. (MQ) Please select the level of education you possess in public administration, business administration, finance, logistics or a related field: Please attach a copy of your degree or transcripts showing when degree was awarded or your application may be deemed incomplete. Options: Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade OR no related degree. | Associate's degree. | Bachelor's degree. | Master's degree or higher.

05. (MQ) Please select the level of progressively responsible professional procurement experience you possess: Options: Less than two (2) years of experience. | Two (2) to less than three (3) years' experience. | Three (3) to less than (5) years' experience. | Five (5) to less than seven (7) years' experience. | Seven (7) or more years' experience.

06. (MQ) Please describe your specific professional procurement experience. Be sure to include the types of duties, projects, and budgets you were responsible for, as well as the name of the employer and the position title you held: This information will need to be identifiable in the work history section of your application or your application may be rejected
07. (MQ) Do you possess at least one year of progressively responsible professional procurement experience in a school district or public agency? Options: Yes | No
08. (MR) Do you possess a Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB) or comparable certification? Please attach a copy of your certification. Options: Yes | No

09. (MR) Certain assignments may require a California driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the Districts vehicle insurance program. Do you possess a valid driver's license? Options: Yes | No
